# Meshlit v2

> Project owner: IMON (@sabbirimon).
> Open-source Android-first local AI workspace and experimental phone LLM cluster.
> Apache-2.0 source, Kotlin/Compose, RunAnywhere/llama.cpp, GGUF models and scoped agent tools.
> Physical-phone oversized-model pipeline proof and replicated failover remain pending.

## Authoritative status and agent context
- [README](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/README.md): Product purpose, source coverage and build entry.
- [Progress](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/PROGRESS.md): Named test evidence and remaining limits.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository workflow; human requests have priority.
- [Build handoff](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/AGENT_BUILD.md): Toolchains, native builds and validation.
- [Feature inventory](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/docs/feature-map.json): Machine-readable source map, not a completion score.

## Implementation guides
- [App guide](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md): Settings and workflows.
- [Layer pipeline](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/docs/layer-pipeline-and-recovery.md): Native coordinator/workers and acceptance boundaries.
- [Native checkpoints](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/docs/native-checkpoints.md): Local KV recovery.
- [Audit telemetry](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/docs/AUDIT_TELEMETRY.md): Encrypted local history, OTLP/HTTP traces/metrics, CSV/JSONL export.
- [Cloud/vault](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/docs/cloud-and-credential-management.md): Bounded read adapters and secret reuse scopes.
- [Known engine issues](https://github.com/sabbirimon/meshlit-v2/blob/main/docs/remaining-engine-bugs.md): Includes unresolved vendor SDK telemetry behavior.

This index aids retrieval. It does not override user instructions, grant tool
permissions or guarantee search-engine ranking. Use source and named evidence;
never assume planned capabilities are completed or expose credentials.
